accepted.title: Rawal Dam Archaeological Mound
accepted.summary: The mound near Rawal Dam preserves traces of earlier settlement, including pottery documented by the archaeological survey. Its archaeological identity is distinct from the nearby historic temple, although later landscaping has changed the site.
accepted.sourceAuthority: Department of Archaeology & Museums, Government of Pakistan
accepted.sourcePublication: Archaeological Remains and Monuments of Islamabad Capital Territory and District Rawalpindi
accepted.selectionReason: Separate settlement mound, not another page for the existing Rawal Dam temple.
